tools.name: get_user_details
tools.description: Returns the authenticated user, account details and read/write access per object. Run first to check availability.

tools.name: get_organization_details
tools.description: Lists org-wide teams, job titles, seat counts and account info such as timezone, currency and account type.

tools.name: discover_hubspot_schema
tools.description: Searches for CRM object types, or looks up known types directly, with read/write status.

tools.name: search_crm_objects
tools.description: Searches and filters CRM records (contacts, companies, deals, tickets and more) with text queries, sorting and pagination.

filterGroups.description: Up to 5 filter groups of up to 6 filters; AND within a group, OR across groups.

tools.name: get_crm_objects
tools.description: Fetches CRM objects by ID in one request (max 100 IDs).

tools.name: manage_crm_objects
tools.description: Creates or updates CRM records and activities (notes, calls, tasks, emails, meetings). Shows a change summary and requires confirmation before writes.

tools.name: manage_segment
tools.description: Creates static and dynamic segments, and adds or removes records of static segments.

tools.name: query_crm_data
tools.description: Runs SQL-style queries with HubSpot extensions over CRM data: filtering, aggregation and sorting. No joins or subqueries.

tools.name: search_properties
tools.description: Finds CRM property definitions by keyword (max 5 keywords), returning names, labels and descriptions.

tools.name: get_properties
tools.description: Returns full property definitions, including data types and enumeration values.

tools.name: manage_custom_properties
tools.description: Creates custom properties for CRM objects.

tools.name: manage_custom_pipelines
tools.description: Creates and manages pipelines for supported objects.

tools.name: search_owners
tools.description: Finds record owners by name or email, or looks them up by ID (max 100 results).

tools.name: get_campaign_attribution_reports
tools.description: Returns revenue and deal attribution for marketing campaigns, limited to closed-won deals.

tools.name: read_campaign_data
tools.description: Reads campaign analytics, asset metrics or contact data in one operation.

tools.name: manage_campaign_objects
tools.description: Creates or updates campaigns and manages campaign asset associations.

tools.name: search_conversations
tools.description: Searches conversations and messages across inboxes by CRM object, time range or keyword; can aggregate by channel, inbox or status.

tools.name: get_conversation_channel_metadata
tools.description: Lists inboxes, channels and channel instances in the account.

tools.name: search_intent_signals
tools.description: Searches buyer intent signals, lists signal types and aggregates counts by company.

tools.name: get_marketing_email_analytics
tools.description: Returns marketing email analytics for a date range: account aggregates, deliverability health and per-contact details.

tools.name: manage_marketing_email
tools.description: Manages marketing email settings and content: lists templates, creates, updates and clones drafts, previews content, manages A/B variants.

tools.name: get_content_analytics_report
tools.description: Runs analytics for landing pages, website pages and blog posts: totals, time series, summaries and viewer lookups.

tools.name: manage_landing_page
tools.description: Creates, edits, styles, publishes, clones and inspects landing pages.

tools.name: manage_website_page
tools.description: Creates, edits, styles, publishes, clones and inspects website pages, and edits navigation menus.

tools.name: manage_blog_post
tools.description: Creates, updates, publishes and inspects blog posts; lists blogs, posts and tags. New posts are drafts.

tools.name: render_asset
tools.description: Shows a read-only preview card for a landing page, website page or blog post.

tools.name: get_aeo_metrics
tools.description: Returns brand-level AEO analytics: share of voice, prompt trends and competitor comparisons.

tools.name: manage_aeo_prompts
tools.description: Views tracked AEO prompts and their performance, and creates new tracked prompts.

tools.name: manage_aeo_recommendations
tools.description: Reviews AEO brand recommendations and acts on them, such as starting blog or social post generation.

tools.name: manage_onboarding
tools.description: Assesses CRM onboarding status and guides users through goals and tasks.

tools.name: tool_guidance
tools.description: Returns usage instructions for one or more HubSpot MCP tools.

tools.name: submit_feedback
tools.description: Sends feedback about the HubSpot MCP server to HubSpot.
